purpose: Version checking and update-transition protocol for Digi stable releases.

version_ordering.rule: Compare corresponding version components from left to right as integers. At the first differing component, the larger integer is newer. Never compare version strings alphabetically.

steps: Fetch latest.json over HTTPS and validate schema, product, version, and release_status.
If release_status is unpublished, do not offer an update.
Compare installed and latest versions numerically; do not downgrade.
Read releases/directory.json and find the entry matching latest_version.
Fetch the metadata_file listed for that version and validate its schema, product, version, and directory against the index.
Validate package filename, HTTPS URL, positive size_bytes, 64-character SHA-256, and matching files inventory.
Download only the selected release asset and display progress.
Verify exact byte size and SHA-256 before passing the candidate to the updater helper.
Replace only the designated installed application executable; preserve Digi user data.
Wait for the new app's startup confirmation and restore the previous executable if confirmation fails.

maintenance.rule: Create and verify version-specific metadata first, add the version to releases/directory.json second, and update latest.json last. Never mark a release published until its actual release asset exists and its size and SHA-256 are verified. Keep prior releases available.
